options.name: api_key_secret
options.description: Illumio PCE API key secret. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_API_KEY_SECRET).

options.name: api_key_username
options.description: Illumio PCE API key username. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_API_KEY_USERNAME).

options.name: href
options.description: HREF of an existing container cluster.

options.name: name
options.description: Container cluster display name. Required for creating a container cluster or when C(href) is not specified.

options.name: pce_hostname
options.description: URL or FQDN of Illumio Policy Compute Engine. C(pce_url) is an alias for C(pce_hostname). Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_PCE_HOST).

options.name: pce_http_proxy
options.description: HTTP proxy server to use when connecting to the PCE. If not set, it will use the default C(http_proxy) environment variable.

options.name: pce_https_proxy
options.description: HTTPS proxy server to use when connecting to the PCE. If not set, it will use the default C(https_proxy) environment variable.

options.name: pce_org_id
options.description: PCE Organization ID. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_PCE_ORG_ID).

options.name: pce_port
options.description: HTTP(S) port used by the PCE. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_PCE_PORT).

options.name: pce_tls_ca
options.description: Path to a custom root CA certificate bundle to use for the PCE connection. If set, overrides C(pce_tls_verify).

options.name: pce_tls_client_certs
options.description: Optional paths to client-side certificate files. May point to separate cert and private key files or a PEM bundle containing both.

options.name: pce_tls_verify
options.description: Flag denoting whether TLS verification should be enabled on the PCE connection.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired container cluster state. If C(present), the cluster will be created if it does not exist, or updated to match the provided parameters if it does. If C(absent), the cluster will be removed if it exists.
